title: Football Opertion Specialist
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before.  Learn more at

THE ROLE: 

Football Operations Specialists are critical to the successful delivery of Genius Sports' officiating and officiating technology services. Operating in live match environments, you will work closely with qualified match officials and Genius Sports leadership to ensure flawless execution before, during, and after each fixture.

You will be trusted to perform under pressure, apply expert knowledge of football and technology, and uphold the highest operational standards in a competition followed by millions worldwide.

Matchday Operations

  • Operate football officiating technology systems during live Brasileirão fixtures.
  • Work directly alongside match officials, supporting decision-making through accurate, timely, and clear technical execution.
  • Identify, retrieve, and present the best possible camera angles and operational outputs in real time.
  • Maintain constant situational awareness during live play, where timing and precision are critical.

Pre-Match Preparation

  • Plan and manage all pre-match operational activities, typically beginning up to three hours before kick-off.
  • Conduct comprehensive system, hardware, and software checks to ensure full readiness.
  • Verify calibration, configuration, and operational integrity in line with Genius Sports SOPs.

Performance Monitoring & Issue Escalation

  • Monitor system performance throughout the match, proactively identifying anomalies or risks.
  • Independently troubleshoot technical issues in high-pressure environments.
  • Escalate issues clearly and professionally to senior operational leadership when required.

Post-Match Duties

  • Complete detailed post-match reports aligned with Genius Sports and CBF requirements.
  • Clip and document relevant match situations to support quality assurance, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to operational feedback loops to enhance future performance.

Operational Excellence & Development

  • Apply and uphold Standard Operating Procedures consistently across all assignments.
  • Contribute to training sessions and scenario-based simulations as part of ongoing development.
  • Support the development of best practices as the partnership with CBF evolves.

What you'll bring:

    • Strong Football Knowledge: Excellent understanding of football, match dynamics, and the Laws of the Game. Prior exposure to officiating environments is highly advantageous.
    • Composure Under Pressure: Proven ability to perform in live match environments where decisions are time-critical and highly scrutinised.
    • Technical Proficiency: Confident working with technology systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently.
    • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to preparation, execution, and reporting.
    • Clear Communication: Professional, calm, and precise communication style, particularly under pressure.
    • Self-Motivated & Accountable: Comfortable working independently as a contractor while representing Genius Sports and CBF to the highest standard.
    • Flexibility: Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and irregular hours aligned to the Brasileirão match calendar, including travel as required.
    Language Skills: Portuguese and English required

Contract & Working Model

  • This is a contractor role, paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hours.
  • Assignments will be scheduled according to competition needs and operational readiness.
  • Contractors will be expected to meet defined performance and availability standards throughout the season.

We enjoy an 'office-first' culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we're committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius .

title: Analista de Planejamento e Controle Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção, manutenção e evolução de modelos financeiros avançados, com foco em simulação de cenários, projeções e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Participar ativamente dos processos de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A), incluindo orçamento anual (OBZ, Opex e Capex), revisões periódicas, forecast e rolling forecast.
  • Realizar análises financeiras integradas, contemplando DRE, Fluxo de Caixa e Balanço, bem como análise de desvios entre realizado, orçado e projetado.
  • Desenvolver análises de viabilidade econômica e avaliação de investimentos, utilizando métricas como VPL, TIR, Payback e ROI.
  • Apoiar a consolidação financeira, com análises por centro de custo, unidade de negócio e projetos, assegurando consistência e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Atuar na gestão e projeção de fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, incluindo modelos de liquidez.
  • Interagir de forma contínua com áreas operacionais, controladoria e liderança, traduzindo análises técnicas em insights financeiros claros e executivos.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria da governança, organização e qualidade dos dados financeiros, garantindo rastreabilidade das premissas e robustez dos modelos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em áreas relacionadas a Finanças, Contabilidade, Economia ou Administração.
  • Experiência prévia em Planejamento Financeiro, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas, com atuação em orçamento e forecast.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem financeira e análise de desvios (real x orçado x forecast).
  • Conhecimento de Excel avançado.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e autônomo, com boa comunicação para interação com múltiplas áreas.
  • Flexibilidade, adaptabilidade e foco em solução em ambientes dinâmicos.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA
Esta posição é para Os Batutinhas, uma das marcas de escola do Inspired no Brasil. Somos uma escola com mais de 20 anos de história formando as nossas crianças para saírem preparadas para enfrentar os desafios do Ensino Fundamental, apaixonados por literatura e com prazer de investigar o mundo. Baseado na teoria construtivista, o trabalho d'Os Batutinhas é ancorado na visão de que a criança assume o lugar de protagonista no seu processo de aprendizagem, construindo conhecimentos sobre o mundo e sobre si mesma.

Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável pela limpeza e organização dos espaços da escola.

RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:

  • Realizar a limpeza e organização dos espaços da escola (pisos, paredes, tetos, sanitários, pias, vidraças, jardins, pátios);
  • Retirar o lixo da unidade;
  • Realizar o transporte de móveis e objetos em geral.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.

*Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.

  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.

  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.

  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.

  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.

  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.

  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels

  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)

  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

  • Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services.  You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund's back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders. 

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience. 

The Impact You'll Have

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data
  • Project manage and delegate to internal teams and collaborators located across the globe.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice-to-Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email. 
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.

Na Porto, Você Importa

A Porto é muito mais que uma seguradora: é um ecossistema gigante que utiliza tecnologia para criar soluções, através de quatro verticais de negócio:
Porto Bank, Porto Saúde, Porto Seguro e Porto Serviço
.
A reputação e o reconhecimento conquistados ao longo de mais de 7 décadas reforçam o tamanho da Porto, uma empresa referência em negócios, feita para e por pessoas.

Aqui, bate no peito de 13 mil colaboradores o
orgulho de fazer parte de uma organização sólida e ética
,
que transforma sonhos em realidades fantásticas
para os nossos mais de 15,8 milhões de clientes. São mais de 101 sucursais e escritórios regionais em todo o Brasil.

O aprendizado faz parte do nosso DNA, e aqui, você terá

DIVERSIDADE & INCLUSÃO NA PORTO
Aqui na Porto, valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que um time plural é imprescindível para o desenvolvimento de todo o nosso negócio, da sociedade, e de cada pessoa, pois entendemos que cada indivíduo é único na construção de um ambiente mais inovador e inclusivo. em todas as nossas vagas.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitivenes (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Que tal sonhar mais alto e começar a construir o seu futuro agora?

Programa de Estágio MRV&CO 2026

Estamos de portas abertas para talentos dispostos a transformar sonhos em realidade e construir o futuro do Brasil de Norte a Sul. Aqui, você não vai só aprender: vai viver experiências práticas e se desenvolver para se tornar um profissional completo. Falar da MRV&CO (MRV, Urba, Luggo, Sensia e Resia) é dizer muito mais do que os títulos que recebemos durante nossa história de 46 anos. Ser uma das maiores construtoras da América Latina nos orgulha muito. Mas não só isso Queremos mais e ir além Somos uma Companhia inovadora e incansável na busca de soluções de moradia. Nos desafiamos e acreditamos na nossa força. E é importante que se evidencie: a força da MRV&CO está em nossa gente. Uma Gente com G maiúsculo, engajada, protagonista, transformadora. Em poucas palavras: um time Sangue Verde

Acreditamos na transparência das relações, na valorização das conquistas e não abrimos mão dos valores que nos trouxeram até aqui. Temos certeza de que dia após dia construímos o futuro que queremos e esse futuro se apresenta em nosso propósito: construir sonhos que transformam o mundo.

Vem #SERSangueVerde com a gente

Descrição do cargo:


O oficineiro de arte e recreação é responsável por planejar e realizar atividades criativas e recreativas que estimulem o desenvolvimento artístico, motor e social dos alunos. Suas atividades incluem:

1. Planejamento e Condução de Oficinas

- Criar e implementar sequências de ensino na área de arte e recreação, desenvolvendo atividades que envolvam diversas formas de expressão artística, como desenho, pintura, teatro, dança e brincadeiras recreativas.

- Conduzir oficinas que abordem técnicas diversas de criação, como desenho, pintura, colagem, modelagem, artesanato, entre outras.

2. Estímulo à Criatividade e à Expressão

- Incentivar a expressão individual e coletiva dos alunos, respeitando diferentes ritmos, interesses e habilidades.

- Criar um ambiente acolhedor e inspirador, que estimule a imaginação e a experimentação artística.

3. Acompanhamento dos Alunos

- Observar e apoiar o desenvolvimento artístico e socioemocional dos participantes.

- Oferecer orientações personalizadas, promovendo autonomia, confiança e habilidades artísticas.


4. Promoção da Interação Social

- Planejar atividades colaborativas que fortaleçam o trabalho em equipe, o respeito mútuo e a convivência.

- Mediar interações para garantir que todos participem de maneira saudável e inclusiva.

5. Organização e Gestão de Materiais

- Gerir materiais e recursos necessários para as oficinas, assegurando seu bom uso, reposição e organização.

- Sugerir compras e melhorias para o espaço das atividades.

Requisitos do Cargo:


Formação

- Formação técnica, tecnóloga ou superior em Artes, Artes Visuais, Educação Artística, Pedagogia com ênfase em Artes ou áreas correlatas.

- Cursos livres, especializações ou vivências relevantes em práticas artísticas serão considerados diferenciais.

Experiência

- Experiência prévia com oficinas artísticas, recreativas ou trabalhos educativos com crianças e adolescentes.

- Vivência em instituições sociais, escolas, ONGs, projetos culturais ou estúdios de arte é desejável.

A DaVita é uma empresa de saúde que oferece serviços de diálise de alta qualidade em todo o Brasil. Chegamos ao Brasil em 2015 e no ano seguinte estávamos com 7 operações. Nossa estratégia de crescimento contínuo e dinâmico conta atualmente com mais de 100 operações.

Estamos presentes em 17 estados, atendendo mais de 20 mil pacientes com um time de mais de 6 mil colegas. No mundo, estamos presentes em 12 países, cuidando de mais de 200 mil pacientes renais em mais de 3 mil centros de diálise.

Atuamos em operações hospitalares e com clínicas para pacientes crônicos, além de um centro de acesso vascular. Prezamos pela Trilogia do Cuidado, pilar que guia a melhoria contínua na vida dos nossos pacientes, dos nossos colegas e do nosso mundo.

Nossos valores refletem o jeito DaVita de ser e imprimem em nosso dia a dia o comprometimento constante com excelência em servir, integridade, trabalho em equipe, aprimoramento contínuo, realização pessoal e diversão.

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage
